mpd_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Music Player Daemon (MPD) server.

mpd_port.description: Port number on which MPD is listening (default: 6600).

mpd_password.description: Password for MPD authentication (leave blank if no password is required).

mpd_music_directory.description: Path to MPD's music directory (used only if cover art lookup is needed; optional).

connection_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait when connecting to MPD before timing out.

max_history_songs.description: Maximum number of songs to retrieve from MPD's playback history.

show_progress.description: If enabled, shows a progress indicator for the currently playing song in the status line.

auto_play.description: If enabled, automatically starts playback when a track change is detected (if supported by the MPD client).

mute_on_pause.description: If enabled, mutes audio output when MPD is paused (e.g., to avoid residual noise from players).

name.description: Descriptive name for the output device.

outputs.description: List of output devices to monitor and display (e.g., for notifications). Each item defines a device's name and type.
